manualFindings: Reviewed the v8.2.5 operation manual pages 15, 26, 40 and 41. The history and download instructions now describe a single PNG for the ordinary screen and project folders for MCP. Development verification results are excluded. Visually checked page 43 of the 47-page manual after updating the pairing and session renewal instructions. The ten-minute and eight-hour guidance matches the runtime.
findings: Reviewed the changed history, ordinary download, restoration, and release instructions against the running app. Compared the unchanged sections with the previously audited candidate. Both languages distinguish ordinary single-PNG downloads and the MCP project export, and the changelog includes flexible panels and the one-time network retry. Compared the new Japanese and English MCP recovery instructions with the heartbeat client, service expiry and real loopback results. v8.2.5 manual PNG wording was checked against Step4Panel and saveImageToChosenLocation: a supported file picker chooses the file; other browsers download a second copy. The automatic single-page download remains independent.

pricingReview.findings: Compared Standard rates on both official tables. GPT-6 Luna is $0.10 input, $0.01 cached and $0.50 output per million short-context tokens. Listed GPT-6.2 and GPT-5.6 route prices match. GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst image input/output is $8/$30 per million. Gemini 3.8 Flash is $0.75/$3.75 per million through December 31, 2026 and Nano Banana 2.1 is $0.0336 per 1K image. Updated reference dates. Standard and Batch are distinct.
